full_judgment:
Mohammad Anwarul Haque J.:- This Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal, is directed against the order dated 01.11.2010 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Misc. Case No. 31667 of 2010 filed under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashment of the order of the learned Sessions Judge passed in Criminal Revision No. 20 of 2008 affirming the judgment and order of acquittal passed by the trial court in a criminal case punishable under section 143/448/323/324/379/ 307/506/109 of the Penal Code. 

 4. On investigation the investigating officer submitted a report with a recommendation to stand trial of the accused-persons for committing the offence punishable under section 143/448/323/324/379/307/506/109 of the Penal Code.
